primary_summary.scope: Previously inspected 22-day atlas cohort requiring old completed zone visits. Initial ten days fit frozen models; prior-pair, expanding and blended models use only mature prior days. Primary eight forward days plus separate two-day extension. Finite preregistered variants, not a search optimized on future results. Equity and martingale are post-evaluation only. Zero-cost bid is a common research price, not executable LONG trading. No live or persistent edge admission.

second_summary.hypothesis: Predict continuation in impulse-oriented coordinates; short the impulse only when predicted continuation-minus-reversal>=0.1, |30s net|>=0.25R. Controls use same amplitude gate.

limits: Inherited X feature construction is not independently rebuilt.
Native bid targets, post-cost fill identities/support, and deterministic accounts are independently reconstructed.
Random controls and exploration on previously inspected dates are descriptive, not proof of a persistent loser.
Uses orient() to reconstruct feature coordinates; reflection invariance and impulse gate have separate tests.
Target and post-cost source replay are covered by first-stage verification.
This is a second exploratory hypothesis after observed first-stage results, not an untouched confirmation.
Previously inspected dates; stage2 invented after inspecting stage1.
Small random-control ensembles and multiple explored variants are not adjusted significance.
Bid is a common research price, not executable long fill.
No equity or staking in entry-selection criterion; sizing is post-evaluation.
Paper bankruptcy does not establish model persistence or inverse trading profitability.
